title: Personal service while in the forum
shortTitle: Personal service while in the forum
summary: Tag jurisdiction refers to personal jurisdiction based on serving an individual while the individual is physically present in the state. Burnham upheld its use on the facts before the Court, with differing reasons.
notes: Do not automatically extend an individual-service holding to corporations or to presence procured by fraud. Tickle addresses a different problem concerning how the defendant was induced to enter the forum.

sections.Meaning: Tag jurisdiction refers to personal jurisdiction based on serving an individual while the individual is physically present in the state. Burnham upheld its use on the facts before the Court, with differing reasons.
sections.How to work through the question: Identify the person served, the location and circumstances of presence, and any objection based on fraud or immunity. Read the separate Burnham rationales: historical acceptance and contemporary fairness were not treated identically by all Justices.
